description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set. The chart is divided into 13 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding data source names and percentage values, and are colored differently, although the exact shades are not distinguishable. The largest slice, labeled "NQ", is blue and accounts for approximately 31.3% of the total, while the smallest slice, labeled "SCIFACT", is a distinct color and represents about 0.1%. The other slices, in descending order of size, are "FEVER" (16.1%), "SNLI" (15.4%), "VITAMINC" (13.0%), "MULTINLI" (11.3%), "ANLI" (4.6%), "FACTCC" (2.6%), "ENTFA" (1.8%), "XSUMHUL" (1.6%), "SCITAIL" (1.2%), "PUBHEALTH" (0.5%), and "MULTIFC" (0.5%). The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by leader lines, and does not have a legend. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The segments are arranged in no particular order.
